definitions.gloss: essay; treatise; study; critical analysis; scholarly article
definitions.explanation: A written work that examines a topic through logical reasoning and analysis. More formal and scholarly than a general essay, typically found in academic or intellectual contexts.

examples.japanese: {近代文学|きんだいぶんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧{論考|ろんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I published an essay on modern literature.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{論考|ろんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え→読み応え：07273_yomigotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This treatise is very substantial and rewarding to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{論考|ろんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}って→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧おり、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The professor's essays cover a wide range of topics and serve as useful references for students.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, discussion) + {考|こう} (thought, consideration). A formal, academic term for a written critical analysis or scholarly essay.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {論考|ろんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to publish an essay/treatise
- {論考|ろんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}する→執筆する：25397_shippitsusuru⟧: to write a scholarly article
- {論考|ろんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{まとめる: to compile a study
- {論考集|ろんこうしゅう}: collection of essays

REGISTER:
Used in academic, intellectual, and literary contexts. Not common in everyday conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {論文|ろんぶん}: thesis, academic paper — more formal; specifically refers to research papers
- {小論|しょうろん}: short essay, brief discussion — shorter and less rigorous
- エッセイ: essay — more personal and informal in tone
